info.title: API.SH: Zameen
info.description: The Zameen API from API.SH: public Zameen data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One Zameen.com listing: title, purpose, state, type, price, rent frequency, bedrooms, bathrooms, area, description, every amenity the advert lists (built year, parking, flooring, utilities, nearby places...), completion, furnishing, occupancy and ownership status, location path with coordinates, verification, tier, reference, dates, photos, videos, floor plans, instalment plan and the agency (name, tier, logo, profile) with the agent's name and phone (an individual's own advert carries no name or phone; `private_seller` says which). Give a zameen.com/Property/ link as `url`, or `latest=true` with the search params to open the first current result.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zameen-listing

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A zameen.com/Property/... listing link (url of a search result).

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: run the search with the other params and open its first current result.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: With latest=true: the search city or area.

parameters.name: purpose
parameters.description: With latest=true: buy or rent.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: With latest=true: property type (as in search).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Property for sale and rent in Pakistan on Zameen.com with the site's filters: city or area, purpose, property type (homes, houses, flats, portions, plots, commercial, offices, shops...), price, area, bedrooms, bathrooms, keywords, listing age, cash or installment payment, occupancy, verified listings, listings with video, minimum photos, plus sort. Each result has id, link, title, purpose, type, price (PKR), rent frequency, bedrooms, bathrooms, area (m²), location path, city, area name and its slug, coordinates, summary, verified flag, listing tier, photo and video counts, cover photo, dates and the agency (id, name, tier, logo, profile) with the agent's name and phone (an individual's own advert carries no name or phone). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zameen-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: A city (lahore, karachi, islamabad, rawalpindi, faisalabad, multan, peshawar, quetta, ...), a Zameen area slug such as Lahore_DHA_Defence-9 (location_slug of a result), or a zameen.com search link.

parameters.name: purpose
parameters.description: Buy or rent.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Property type.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum price (PKR).

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum price (PKR).

parameters.name: area_min
parameters.description: Minimum area (m²).

parameters.name: area_max
parameters.description: Maximum area (m²).

parameters.name: bedrooms
parameters.description: Bedrooms, comma list (0 = studio).

parameters.name: bathrooms
parameters.description: Bathrooms, comma list, e.g. `2,3`.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: Words the listing must contain, e.g. `corner`.

parameters.name: added
parameters.description: Only listings added within this period.

parameters.name: payment
parameters.description: For sale only: cash price or installment plans.

parameters.name: occupancy
parameters.description: Occupancy status.

parameters.name: verified
parameters.description: true: verified listings only.

parameters.name: has_video
parameters.description: true: listings with a video only.

parameters.name: photos_min
parameters.description: Listings with at least this many photos (1-50).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Result page (1 = first).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
